text.en:
Section two of Act Numbered Eighteen hundred and twenty-nine is hereby amended to read as
"Section 2. Municipal teachers shall have charge of said lectures, the number of which for each quarter shall
be determined by the Bureau of Education."

This Act shall take effect upon its passage.
Enacted, December 4, 1914.
